top.line: The business model: readers' money flowing back to the sources they read, simulated and in the open.

in-short.line: Pay by the read; share with sources; 504 sources behind 112 pages; licences; a register; no lock-in.

loop.line: Better sources, better pages, more readers, more for the sources: a positive loop.

simulation.line: 30% for costs, £3.50 of £5 shared, weighted by use; worked out in the reader's browser.

licence.line: Every value carries a licence link, checked by the build; 92 sources on the register.

gaps.line: Ask the sources that do not allow us, and make paying them part of the offer.

open.line: Everything published; anyone can build on it; we sell the service around it.

limits.line: Simulated; weights a proposal; licences started today.

sources.line: The simulated payout page, the register and the team's guidance.
